text:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — high rate of billing/overage flags in prod-eu1. Symptom: sudden spike in customer overage emails and token counts. Rule: metering.overage_spike. Please ack.

alice_oncall: ack — taking. Starting investigation.

alice_oncall: quick glance at metrics: emit-rate has a sharp spike + consumer lag on metering-ingest (eu1).

bob_billing: seeing elevated token deltas in shadow-agg window 03:10-03:20. Possible duplicate events from emitter retries. Running quick query.

carmen_sre: I see emitter-eu1-0 had OOMKilled at 03:12 followed by rapid restarts. Logs show retry storms. Pasting snippet.

carmen_sre: ```
[03:12:07] emitter WARN retrying message id=abc123 status=500
[03:12:12] emitter ERROR failed to ack record partition=12 offset=34567
[03:12:14] jvm GC pause 1200ms
```

alice_oncall: that fits duplicate-id + reprocessing story. Bob, can you run a reconciliation on top customers and check event_id uniqueness?

bob_billing: running: ```sql
SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) as cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) as uniq FROM metering.events 
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-20T03:30:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Will post results in ~2m.

david_support: support queue: 3 customers reported overage emails (Tkt#2345, #2346, #2347). Elaine tagging.

elaine_cs: noted, standing by for impact scope. Drafted holding language. Do not send until we confirm.

bob_billing: results: top customers show cnt > uniq by ~1.8-2.1x. Shadow-agg contains duplicate event_ids. Looks like emitter retries with non-idempotent writes.

alice_oncall: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause overage alerts for eu1 2) scale metering-ingest consumers to drain backlog 3) launch idempotent backfill/dedupe for the affected window.

alice_oncall: executed: `./runbook pause-alerts --scope eu1 --rule metering.overage_spike` — alerting paused.

incident-bot: Alerting rule metering.overage_spike paused by alice_oncall at 03:18 UTC.

carmen_sre: scaled metering-ingest consumers x2 and triggered partition rebalance. Consumer lag decreasing.

bob_billing: starting backfill: `python tools/backfill_dedupe.py --env prod-eu1 --start 2026-03-20T03:00:00Z --end 2026-03-20T03:30:00Z` — ETA ~25m. Logging run id bf-877.

david_support: do we need to proactively refund or cancel invoices for affected customers?

bob_billing: will compute corrected usage once backfill completes. If corrected delta > credit_threshold we'll issue adjustments. Owning billing adjustments.

alice_oncall: customer-impact summary so far: 3 customers received overage emails; no automated billing charges applied yet (deferred). Elaine, hold comms until we validate corrected numbers.

elaine_cs: holding. Suggested template: "We're investigating an incorrect overage notification; no action required. We'll follow up with corrected usage and credits if applicable."

bob_billing: backfill job bf-877 completed at 03:40 UTC. Preliminary reconciliation: total tokens in affected window reduced by ~48% after dedupe. Duplicate event_id patterns confirmed. Generating corrected usage report now.

alice_oncall: ingress stabilized, consumers caught up, backfill finished. Marking incident mitigated — follow-up required for RCA and permanent fix.

alice_oncall: immediate action items assigned: 
- emitter memory fix + add oom kill alert => owner carmen_sre
- strengthen emitter idempotency/dedupe => owner bob_billing
- add automated nightly reconciliation smoke check => owner eng-infra (follow-up ticket)

bob_billing: started invoice correction workflow. Will coordinate with finance for credits and notify customers once numbers final.

elaine_cs: prepping customer comms; ETA 1h to finalize with corrected numbers.

alice_oncall: handing off post-mitigation work to owners. Tagging: @carmen_sre, @bob_billing, @elaine_cs. Creating follow-up JIRA.

incident-bot: Incident status: P1 -> mitigated at 03:42 UTC; closed at 03:45 UTC. Follow-up ticket INF-4821 created for RCA and fixes.

alice_oncall: final notes: root cause appears to be emitter OOM leading to retry storm + non-idempotent writes causing duplicate events and inflated token counts. Lessons: add memory headroom, enforce idempotent publish ids, and automated end-to-end reconciliation to catch duplicates earlier.

bob_billing: I'll attach reconciliation SQL and diff artifacts to INF-4821. Also recommending a short-term hotpatch to dedupe by event_id during ingest.

carmen_sre: will open infra PR for increased JVM heap / liveness probe and add OOM alert to k8s metrics.

elaine_cs: will wait for final corrected report before sending customer note.

alice_oncall: thanks all — monitoring for 1hr then closing channel. Please add any follow-ups to the JIRA. :thumbsup:
